workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free for the partners' meeting next week:

*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue: 13:00, 13:30
*   Wed: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 10:00, 14:30
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Could you please check these against Elena's and David's calendars and let me know which one works for them? I'll then book it. Thanks, Alison.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars against your list. The only time that works for all four partners is Thursday, November 19, at 14:30. Please go ahead and book it. I'll send the confirmation email once you're done. Thanks, Brad.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Excellent! Thanks, Brad. I'll book it now.
